title: nmea0183: Add GLL sentence dissector
description:
Add sentence dissector for GLL messages.

* It uses the existing dissector for the latitude, longitude and time field.
* It splits the latitude and longitude into separate degree and minute fields.
* The status and mode indicator reports the human readable values
* Report an expected but missing field

### Tested

This pcap contains valid and invalid variants of GLL sentence: [nmea-test-messages.pcapng](/uploads/b1d52f8324cf342bbdb9b697183e98ff/nmea-test-messages.pcapng)

I have run 500 iterations of `fuzz-test.sh` with that capture.

notes.body:
Hi,
As this dissector is actively updated it should be coverted to use C99 types. We have a script to do that https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/tools/convert-glib-types.py This is probably better done in a separate MR. Note glib function should still use gboolean where appropriate. 
Best regards
Anders
